subject: DPA / SCCs: confirm role mapping + signature routing for Order Form
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rutter <trutter@novamed.com>, contracts@novamed.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Novamed DPA redlines + Order Form signature path

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is ready to move to contract. Attached are our consolidated redlines to the DPA ("Novamed_DPA_redlines_v3.docx") and an updated Order Form reflecting the headcount-based commitment we discussed. A few items we want to confirm before routing to our legal: 

- Controller/processor mapping: Novamed needs explicit processor-only language for the embeddings API and the private deployment path.
- SCCs: we prefer the EU SCCs Annex compatibility approach you outlined, but need to see an annotated mapping so our counsel can sign off.
- Evidence items: can Redwood confirm the SOC2 scope for dedicated pools and provide KMS options?

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the DPA redline walkthrough and the signature flow (DocuSign vs in-house)? We have a hard go-live window of 2026-04-12 so we'd like to lock the execution path this week.

Attachments: Novamed_DPA_redlines_v3.docx, OrderForm_Novamed_v2.pdf

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Procurement, Novamed
elena.morris@novamed.com
+1 415-555-0122
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novamed DPA redlines + Order Form signature path

Elena — thanks for the materials and for the timeline. Laura here (Contracts / Partnerships). I will own the DPA redline walkthrough with your counsel. For the execution path I'd like to loop in Ben on procurement/signature routing and Jordan for the MSA+OrderForm redline alignment.

Immediate answers to your asks:
- Controller/Processor: we can produce an explicit Processor-only clause for the embeddings and private deploys; Jordan will propose the exact language by EOD.
- SCCs: Jordan will share an annotated SCCs mapping spreadsheet (I prefer that to inline redline comments) and we will confirm compatibility with the EU SCCs approach.
- SOC2 & KMS: Ben will confirm SOC2 scope and supply a KMS options note (HSM + customer-managed KMS options).

Proposed next steps:
1) Jordan to circulate SCCs_role_map_annotated.xlsx and proposed MSA clause by Tue 24 Mar.
2) Ben to attach SOC2 scope statement and KMS options by Tue end of day.
3) Quick call Wed 25 Mar (30m) for live walkthrough with Novamed legal to finalize sign-off path.

If that timeline works we will prepare a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form (preferred) and a separate DPA execution (or combined if counsel prefers).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novamed DPA redlines + Order Form signature path

Elena/Laura — looping in procurement perspective.

Quick notes from our side:
- SOC2: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted inference control plane and dedicated pool operations. I attached the short SOC2 scope memo and the standard evidence checklist in the shared Drive link. We can provide the full report under NDA; let me know which artifacts Novamed requires.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (bring-your-own-key) for private deployments; for Hosted API we offer envelope encryption with HSM-backed root keys. If Novamed wants HSM attestations we can coordinate an addendum.
- Signature path: DocuSign preferred. We can prepare two envelopes: (1) Order Form + MSA signature; (2) DPA + SCCs annex. If Novamed wants a single combined package we can do that too but counsel sometimes prefers separate DPA sign-off.

I attached OrderForm_Novamed_v2.pdf with redline-friendly bookmarks and will open the DocuSign envelope once we confirm final files after the Wed call.

Ben Carter
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: SCCs / role mapping and proposed clause language

Elena — attached is the spreadsheet (SCCs_role_map_annotated.xlsx) that maps our processing activities to the EU SCCs annex fields and highlights the controller/processor split for each API surface. Key calls outs:

- Embeddings API: process-only language + K-anonymization recommendation for training data if Novamed opts to store vectors.
- Private deployment (VPC/on-prem): Redwood remains processor; where Novamed requests subprocessor changes we will add notice windows into the DPA.
- Transfer impact addendum: we propose a short addendum that references the SCCs mapping and lists fallback hosting actions (region pinning, dedicated pool routing) — see tab 'TransferAddendumDraft'.

Proposed MSA clause (excerpt):
"Redwood acts as Processor as to any Customer Data supplied for inference unless otherwise expressly agreed in an Order Form. For avoidance of doubt, use of Redwood's hosted embeddings service does not transfer Controller responsibilities to Redwood and Customer retains any obligations under applicable data protection law."

If Novamed prefers stronger controller-side assurances (e.g., contractual covenants around purpose limitation) flag them and I'll incorporate.

I can present the mapping on the Wed call and walk counsel through the rationale.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rutter <trutter@novamed.com>, contracts@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCCs / role mapping and proposed clause language

Thanks Jordan — the mapping is exactly the level of detail our counsel asked for. A couple of follow-ups: 

- For the embeddings note, our counsel wants explicit language that Redwood will not use Customer vectors for model retraining without consent (we flagged that in the redlines).
- Transfer addendum: we prefer the addendum to include a short operational fallback (30–60 minute region failover SLA for dedicated pools) in addition to the SCCs references — is that something Redwood can commit to?
- Evidence: we attached our vendor questionnaire as well (Novamed_vendor_questionnaire.pdf). Please advise which items you can answer directly on the questionnaire and which will require SOC2/attestation attachments.

We are available for the Wed 25 Mar 14:00 PT walkthrough if you can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Elena
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <ben.jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCCs / role mapping and proposed clause language

Elena — thanks for the quick review and the questionnaire. Confirming next actions and owners after today's walkthrough: 

- Jordan: will add the "no-use-for-retraining-without-consent" clause to the DPA redline and update the TransferAddendumDraft to include a short operational fallback (we cannot commit to a hard 30-min failover SLA for cross-region network events today, but we will propose a dedicated-pool failover commitment with an operational runbook and an escalation ladder). Target: updated DPA + TransferAddendum by Fri 27 Mar EOD.
- Ben: will prepare the DocuSign envelopes once Laura confirms final attachments; Ben will also populate the vendor questionnaire responses for the SOC2/KMS items (we will mark items that require full-report NDA). Target: Fri 27 Mar close of business.
- Laura (me): I will schedule the DocuSign routing to Novamed and confirm signer order (Novamed signers then Redwood). Also I'll send the Wed call notes and the calendar invite for the 25 Mar walkthrough (apologies — invite will reflect PST/California timezone).

Provisional plan for execution to meet 2026-04-12 go-live: finalize DPA + Order Form by 2026-03-27; complete signatures by 2026-04-01; onboarding/ops kickoff 2026-04-05.

Attachments reference: Novamed_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (received).

Thanks everyone — will send the calendar invite and the updated artifacts as they land.

Laura
